top_signals.title: CFOs Face a Tougher Call on When to Borrow
top_signals.summary: It’s been a good year for CFOs looking to borrow. Credit markets have largely remained open despite the war in Iran, spreads have been low and investors have been eager to buy. Mozilla CFO Eric Muhlheim and Bloomberg's Nina Trentmann discuss the impact of AI on capex spend, corporate strategy, and company principles in our CFO Briefing. They speak with Bloomberg Businessweek Daily hosts Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: FBI’s Memphis Cargo Theft Task Force warns cyber schemes put millions in freight at risk
top_signals.summary:
Criminals can know exactly what freight they want before arriving for pickup. The FBI’s Memphis Cargo Theft Task Force says cyber-enabled schemes are changing how thieves target shipments.
